_help: Paid campaigns. Add one block per advertiser and push. Fields: id = short lowercase name, no spaces (used in report and tracked links); company; url = the advertiser's own https application page; start and until = campaign dates (YYYY-MM-DD); title, pay, blurb = what the Featured card shows; pin = false for Instagram/WhatsApp-only campaigns (not pinned on the site). Pinned roles show with a 'Sponsored' label at the top of the homepage and All roles page from 'start' to 'until', then disappear by themselves. Tracked links for posts: /go/sponsored-<id>?src=ig (Instagram) or ?src=wa (WhatsApp). Report links are listed on your private /report page. Pay per click: add "cpc": 1.5 and "budget": 100 (GBP). Clicks are counted once per person per day; when budget / cpc clicks are reached the listing stops being pinned by itself (links keep working).
